intro: Choose what Rafii may do for you in this workspace. Your role still decides what you can do; these choices can only narrow it.

read_analyze.title: Read and summarize
read_analyze.summary: Look at drafts, campaigns, the calendar, your Library and other workspace records to answer you.

navigate_interact.title: Find your way around
navigate_interact.summary: Open pages, point at buttons and walk you through steps.

create_edit.title: Create and edit drafts
create_edit.summary: Write drafts, edit them, make images and add drafts to campaigns.

manage_settings.title: Change settings
manage_settings.summary: Change workspace and voice settings when you ask.

manage_connected_services.title: Connected accounts
manage_connected_services.summary: Rafii never connects or disconnects accounts. It can take you to the page where you do.

execute_automations.title: Schedules and automations
execute_automations.summary: Prepare schedules and automation changes for you to approve. Nothing is posted until you approve it.

recommended.title: Recommended
recommended.summary: Rafii reads, finds things and drafts for you. Settings, accounts, schedules and automations always ask first. Paid work asks first.

full.title: Full
full.summary: Rafii does everything your role allows without asking, except posting, approving and anything that needs your own confirmation. You sign in again to choose this.

none.title: Off
none.summary: Rafii only answers help questions and shows you around.

legacy.title: Current (before permissions)
legacy.summary: Rafii works the way it always has until you choose.

spend.none: Spends credits without asking (your plan limits still apply)
spend.media: Asks before spending credits on images

revoke.title: Turn off Rafii's access
revoke.summary: Rafii stops using everything at once. Help and navigation still work.

notRecallable.sent_to_model_provider: What Rafii already read was sent to its AI model and can't be called back.
notRecallable.visible_in_past_answers: Earlier answers in your conversations stay as they are.
notRecallable.already_applied_changes: Changes Rafii already made stay. You can undo them yourself.

reminder.title: Choose what Rafii may do
reminder.summary: Rafii works as it always has. You can choose what it may do for you now, or later.

shadow: Preview: these choices are saved but not enforced yet.
